what: Vendor blake3-servil (johnservil/BLAKE3 rev c6bd679a0911cc233cb28297f2b25875381215a1, root Cargo.toml:193) as vendor/blake3-servil with a SOURCE.md, as vendor/sonic-rs and vendor/cranelift-codegen are, and point the workspace dependency at the path. tools/nix/unit_graph.py takes only registry and path sources and stops on it: "step 'nix': unsupported source git+https://github.com/johnservil/BLAKE3?rev=c6bd679...", so tools/nix/units/*.json can't be regenerated (01012) and nix-live's staleness gate can't pass.
why: 01012: daemon.json still names salsa 256 times and Wasmtime/proc-macro-srv 522 times after the port and dedup-engines' removals. A git source also isn't something units.nix can fetch reproducibly without a hash.
